name: workspace
description: Simple camera barcode scanner. Scan, enter product name, shelf qty, stock qty and comment, then Save. Each save adds a timestamped row (newest on top) to a Google Sheet through an Apps Script web app (`Code.gs`).

scripts.test: node test/decode.test.js && node test/pages.test.js && node test/ach.test.js && node test/onboarding.test.js
